scenarios.name: Companion startup
scenarios.preconditions: Windows 11 X64, Node.js v24.19.0, port 7000 free, RC extracted to isolated directory.
scenarios.procedure: Run .\bin\start-companion.ps1 directly; then test with per-process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass and direct node dist/index.mjs after isolated stremio-addon-sdk install; test port conflict and directory path containing spaces.
scenarios.expected: Companion launches cleanly via start-companion.ps1 from extracted RC, binds exclusively to 127.0.0.1:7000, handles spaces in path, and /companion/health returns 200 OK.
scenarios.observed: THREE REAL WINDOWS DEFECTS FOUND: (1) Direct .\bin\start-companion.ps1 blocked by default ExecutionPolicy (PSSecurityException UnauthorizedAccess). (2) Standalone extracted RC fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: stremio-addon-sdk (not bundled; package.json has workspace:*). (3) Path containing spaces causes src/index.ts isDirectRun (import.meta.url.endsWith) to evaluate false (%20 vs space), exiting silently with code 0. With isolated stremio-addon-sdk in a non-space path and per-process Bypass, Companion started on 127.0.0.1:7000 (verified via netstat -ano), /companion/health returned 200 OK, and port conflict exited code 1 with clear message.
scenarios.evidence: Native Windows execution logs; netstat -ano TCP 127.0.0.1:7000 LISTENING; no screenshot captured.
scenarios.observations: Fails out-of-the-box RC standalone execution and spaces-in-path requirement; core HTTP server works once stremio-addon-sdk is supplied in a non-space path.

scenarios.name: Manifest access
scenarios.preconditions: Companion running natively on 127.0.0.1:7000 (with isolated stremio-addon-sdk).
scenarios.expected: Valid JSON manifest with id com.subtitleme.addon and version 1.0.0-rc.1.
scenarios.observed: HTTP 200 OK returned valid JSON with id 'com.subtitleme.addon', version '1.0.0-rc.1', name 'SubtitleMe', resources ['subtitles'], types ['movie','series'], and full config schema.
scenarios.evidence: Native Windows HTTP response verified via Node fetch; Chrome DevTools remote debugging unavailable so no browser screenshot captured.
scenarios.observations: Manifest payload and CORS header (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *) verified natively on Windows.

scenarios.name: Install addon in Stremio Desktop
scenarios.preconditions: Stremio Desktop 5.0.28 installed; Companion live on 127.0.0.1:7000; configured manifest URL generated.
scenarios.procedure: Paste configured http://127.0.0.1:7000/<config>/manifest.json in Stremio Desktop Addons -> + Add Addon and install.
scenarios.expected: SubtitleMe appears installed in Stremio Addons list.
scenarios.observed: Not executed in Stremio Desktop GUI. No desktop GUI automation available for stremio-shell-ng.exe, and user elected to close validation without interactive GUI run. Configured manifest URL generation was verified natively via POST /companion/install-url (200 OK).
scenarios.observations: Requires human-operated GUI interaction in Stremio Desktop 5.0.28.

scenarios.observed: GUI reload not executed. Native Windows DELETE /companion/subtitles/:id returned 200 OK and immediate re-request of the previously generated /generated/<opaqueToken>.vtt returned 404 Not Found.
scenarios.evidence: Native Windows HTTP verification only; no Stremio Desktop screenshot.
scenarios.observations: Immediate cache invalidation verified natively; Stremio Desktop reload behavior pending.
